businessCountry.description: The two-letter ISO country code of the organization's business address.

billingEmail.description: The billing email address for the organization.

plan.description:
The name of the plan the organization is subscribed to.
It is unclear why this is stored and what it is used for - do not use it.
Use the Bit.Core.AdminConsole.Entities.Organization.PlanType instead.

seats.description: The number of user seats included in the organization's subscription. NULL if the plan has no seat limit.

maxCollections.description: The maximum number of collections the organization can create. NULL if the plan has no collection limit.

usePolicies.description: If true, the organization has access to the Policies feature.

useSso.description: If true, the organization has access to the SSO (Single Sign-On) feature.

useKeyConnector.description: If true, the organization has access to the Key Connector feature, which allows SSO without master passwords.

useScim.description:
If true, the organization has access to the SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) feature.
This is used for automatic user provisioning.

useGroups.description: If true, the organization has access to the Groups feature.

useDirectory.description:
If true, the organization can use Directory Connector.
This is a standalone app used for automatic user provisioning.

useEvents.description: If true, the organization has access to the event logs feature.

useTotp.description: If true, the organization has access to the TOTP feature for vault items.

use2fa.description: If true, the organization has access to organization-level two-factor authentication.

useApi.description: If true, the organization has access to the public API.

useResetPassword.description: If true, the organization has access to the account recovery (admin password reset) feature.

useSecretsManager.description: If true, the organization is subscribed to the Secrets Manager product.

selfHost.description:
If true, the organization can export a license file which is used to create the organization on
a self-hosted instance. It does not indicate whether this organization is self-hosted.

usersGetPremium.description: If true, all members of the organization are granted premium features.

useCustomPermissions.description: If true, the organization has access to custom user roles with fine-grained permissions.

storage.description: The number of bytes of file attachment storage the organization has used.

maxStorageGb.description: The maximum number of gigabytes of file attachment storage available to the organization.

gatewayCustomerId.description: The organization's customer ID in the payment gateway.

gatewaySubscriptionId.description: The organization's subscription ID in the payment gateway.

referenceData.description: A JSON blob of reference data, e.g. the signup source.

enabled.description:
If true, the organization is active. If false, the organization is disabled and access to its
vault and features are restricted.

licenseKey.description: The license key for the organization. Used by self-hosted instances to validate the license.

publicKey.description: The organization's asymmetric public key, used to enrol members in account recovery.

privateKey.description: The organization's asymmetric private key, encrypted with the organization's symmetric key.

twoFactorProviders.description:
A JSON blob of the organization's two-factor authentication provider configurations.
Use M:Bit.Core.AdminConsole.Entities.Organization.GetTwoFactorProviders and M:Bit.Core.AdminConsole.Entities.Organization.SetTwoFactorProviders(System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary{Bit.Core.Auth.Enums.TwoFactorProviderType,Bit.Core.Auth.Models.TwoFactorProvider}) to read and write this field.

expirationDate.description: The date the organization's license expires. NULL if the license does not expire.

creationDate.description: The date the organization was created.

revisionDate.description: The date the organization was last updated.

maxAutoscaleSeats.description: The maximum number of seats the organization can autoscale to. NULL if autoscaling is not limited.

ownersNotifiedOfAutoscaling.description:

NULL if owners have not been notified.

usePasswordManager.description:
If true, the organization has access to the Password Manager product.
This is intended for future use if we separate Password Manager from Secrets Manager (and other products).
For now, all organizations and users implicitly have access to Password Manager.

smSeats.description:
The number of Secrets Manager seats included in the organization's subscription.
NULL if the organization does not have access to Secrets Manager.

smServiceAccounts.description:
The number of Secrets Manager machine accounts (service accounts) included in the organization's subscription.
NULL if the organization does not have access to Secrets Manager.

maxAutoscaleSmSeats.description:
The maximum number of Secrets Manager seats the organization can autoscale to.
NULL if autoscaling is not limited.

maxAutoscaleSmServiceAccounts.description:
The maximum number of Secrets Manager machine accounts the organization can autoscale to.
NULL if autoscaling is not limited.

limitCollectionCreation.description:
If set to true, only owners, admins, and some custom users can create and delete collections.
If set to false, any organization member can create a collection, and any member can delete a collection that
they have Can Manage permissions for.

limitCollectionDeletion.description:
If set to true, only owners, admins, and some custom users can delete collections.
If set to false, any member can delete a collection that they have Can Manage permissions for.

allowAdminAccessToAllCollectionItems.description:
If set to true, admins, owners, and some custom users can read/write all collections and items in the Admin Console.
If set to false, users generally need collection-level permissions to read/write a collection or its items.

limitItemDeletion.description:
If set to true, members can only delete items when they have a Can Manage permission over the collection.
If set to false, members can delete items when they have a Can Manage OR Can Edit permission over the collection.

useRiskInsights.description:
If true, the organization can use the Risk Insights feature. This is a reporting feature that provides
insights into the security of an organization.

useOrganizationDomains.description: If true, the organization can claim domains, which unlocks additional enterprise features.

useAdminSponsoredFamilies.description: If set to true, admins can initiate organization-issued sponsorships.

syncSeats.description: If set to true, organization needs their seat count synced with their subscription.

useAutomaticUserConfirmation.description:
If set to true, the organization can use the automatic user confirmation feature.
This automatically confirms users in the Accepted state without requiring manual admin intervention.
There are significant security risks to this and access is manually controlled by our internal teams.

useDisableSmAdsForUsers.description: If set to true, disables Secrets Manager ads for users in the organization

usePhishingBlocker.description: If set to true, the organization can use the phishing blocker feature.

useMyItems.description:
If set to true, My Items collections will be created automatically when the Organization Data Ownership
policy is enabled.

useInviteLinks.description: If set to true, the organization can generate reusable sharable invite links to invite users to the organization.

exemptFromBillingAutomation.description:
When set to true, the organization is excluded from automated billing
lifecycle operations such as subscription cancellation and disabling for non-payment.

organizationId.description: The ID of the Organization that the user is a member of.

userId.description:
The ID of the User that is the member. This is NULL if the Status is Invited (or Invited and then Revoked), because
it is not linked to a specific User yet.

email.description:
The email address of the user invited to the organization. This is NULL if the Status is not Invited (or
Invited and then Revoked), because in that case the OrganizationUser is linked to a User
and the email is stored on the User object.

key.description:
The Organization symmetric key encrypted with the User's public key. NULL if the user is not in a Confirmed
(or Confirmed and then Revoked) status.

resetPasswordKey.description:
The User's symmetric key encrypted with the Organization's public key. NULL if the OrganizationUser
is not enrolled in account recovery.

externalId.description:
An ID used to identify the OrganizationUser with an external directory service. Used by Directory Connector
and SCIM.

creationDate.description: The date the OrganizationUser was created, i.e. when the User was first invited to the Organization.

permissions.description:
A json blob representing the Bit.Core.Models.Data.Permissions of the OrganizationUser if they
are a Custom user role (i.e. the Bit.Core.Enums.OrganizationUserType is Custom). MAY be NULL if they are not
a custom user, but this is not guaranteed; do not use this to determine their role.

Indicates if the organization claimed the user. If a user is "claimed" by an organization,
the organization has greater control over their account, and some user actions are restricted.
